extensionDescription.message: Warns about Cyrillic and lookalike letters in hostnames, including URL-shaped Google searches.

permissionNote.message: Leave unchecked to allow it only in this tab.

settingsIntro.message: Hostnames saved with “Always allow this hostname”. Remove one to check it again the next time you open it.

emptyList.message: No saved hostnames. To add one, select “Always allow this hostname” on the warning page and continue.

storageNote.message: Your allowed sites are stored in this Chrome profile on this device. They are not sent to an external service or synced to other devices.

removalNote.message: Removing a hostname also revokes its tab-only permissions. Pages that are already open will stay open.

noHostnameNote.message: Character differences appear here when a hostname needs your attention.

searchStopped.message: The search results have been hidden.

accessStopped.message: Navigation to this hostname was blocked.

reopenURL.message: Open the original URL again before choosing whether to continue.

warningUnavailable.message: Could not verify this warning. Open the original URL again.

permissionRemoved.message: Removed permission for “$1”. It will be checked the next time you open it.

checkCharacters.message: Check the character differences before continuing.

listBackgroundFailed.message: Could not update allowed sites. Please try again.

pendingMissing.message: This warning has expired. Open the original URL again.

permissionInvalid.message: Could not verify the permission setting.

continueRetry.message: Could not continue. Please try again.
